title: DJU-BEI on LP2-27 and LP2-55
question: Does the reported six-rune DJU-BEI sequence occur at the stated rune offsets on LP2-27 and LP2-55?
summary: The exact sequence appears once on each specified archived page: zero-based rune offsets 28 and 70, with the same visible word separator.

scope.representation: The archived raw rune transcription on each of the two specified pages. The stream keeps only the 29 Gematria Primus runes, including headings, and resets the offset at each page.
scope.procedure: Scan all six-rune windows on each specified page for the exact rune sequence ᛞᛄᚢᛒᛖᛁ; record zero- and one-based positions and the original source slice including separators.
scope.parameters: One fixed six-rune target; no matching across a page boundary; punctuation and line breaks excluded from the offset.
scope.exclusions: Other manuscript pages, image-level transcription adjudication, plaintext or cipher inference, significance testing and a causal relation to doublet suppression.

finding: LP2-27 has exactly one occurrence at zero-based rune offset 28 (line 2, columns 11–17); LP2-55 has exactly one at offset 70 (line 4, columns 4–10). Both source slices are ᛞᛄᚢ-ᛒᛖᛁ.
limitations: The two target pages and sequence were supplied after the pattern was noticed. This is a transcription-bound location check, not a prospectively selected statistical test or a demonstration of a decoding mechanism.
next_steps: A proposed use of the recurrence should specify a complete operation that predicts other unseen pages or words, then test it on held-out material with the same offset convention.
